notes:
- Primary objective: reduce live-agent volume via high-precision RAG for support agent and ticket deflection.
- POC scope: 1M-5M indexed documents (tickets + KB + transcripts) then scale to 10M.
- Latency SLO: end-to-end retrieval+rerank median <60ms, p95 <120ms; must show evidence for 99th percentile under 250ms in US regions.
- Quality target: precision@5 >= 90-95% for reranker on top-5; business cares about top-5 recall for deflection.
- Cost target: <$0.02 per query (including embeddings + rerank) for typical 4-8 retrievals + lightweight cross-encoder reranker.
- Data: mix of short tickets (avg 120 tokens), KB articles (avg 800 tokens), call transcript excerpts. PII must be redacted before embedding; legal asks for audit log retention 12 months and selective residency for EU customers.
- Deployment preference: start on Dedicated VPC in us-east for POC, consider Private (VPC+on-prem) for regulated vertical customers.
- Internal quote from Head of Support: "We will not accept >200ms tail latency for a primary deflection flow."
- Technical note: evaluating bi-encoder ANN vector store for retrieval + cross-encoder re-ranker for final top-5. Want Redwood Optimize to advise quantization and batching to hit SLOs without losing quality.
- Requested deliverables from Redwood: benchmark report (latency/cost/quality), canary rollout plan, security questionnaire answers, and example SAML configuration for Azure AD.

requirements_summary:
- Indexing scale: initial 1M docs, target 10M in 6 months.
- Retrieval: ANN latency budget per query 20-50ms (ann+io).
- Reranker: cross-encoder p95 rerank latency target 30-70ms; overall E2E <120ms p95.
- Throughput: 500 qps sustained for peak support windows; burst up to 2k qps.
- Rerank quality: top-5 precision target 90-95% for KB+tickets.
- Cost: target <$0.02 per end-to-end query.
- Compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2, selectable EU residency, audit logs, KMS integration.
- Integration: Zendesk + internal ticketing data pipeline, streaming incremental indexing.
poc_details:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): index 100k tickets + 10k KB, baseline with existing vendor, run Redwood hosted and dedicated micro-benchmarks.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): dedicated VPC POC with 1M docs, candidate retriever/reranker combos: faiss/annoy + distilled cross-encoder; measure p95/p99 and precision@5.
- Phase 3 (ongoing): scale to 5-10M, test batching, KV cache, quantization recommended by Redwood Optimize; integrate with Zendesk for deflection telemetry.
